name: Integrated Proteins Limited
about: Integrated Proteins Limited engages in the trading and processing of various oil seeds in India. It is involved in extracting, manufacturing, producing, refining, crushing, purchasing, selling, importing, exporting, and dealing in edible, non-edible, deodorized, refined, vegetable oils, and oil cake by crushing with or without addition of chemicals and substances from soybeans, groundnuts, cotton seeds, rape seeds, and sunflower seeds, as well as other oil seeds, nuts, cakes, cereals, or other oil bearing substances. The company is also involved in the trading of agri-commodity products for industrial and commercial applications. Integrated Proteins Limited was incorporated in 1992 and is based in Jamnagar, India.
